tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send a payment because Cobalt Labs (vendor V-790) has two approved invoices, not one, and I can't tell which one you mean:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-89190 | $3,526.06 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-15523 | $7,693.96 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

The vendor's other two invoices don't qualify. INV-26154 ($7,323.71) is already paid, and INV-28385 ($7,523.69) is a draft still awaiting approval. The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so nothing has gone out to this vendor.

Which invoice should I pay: INV-89190, INV-15523 or both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), use a unique key so it can't be paid twice, and send you the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-15523, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-15523, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-15523 in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-15523 (Cobalt Labs, V-790), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $7,693.96
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

The payment list shows this as the only payment, so it went out once. I also attached a unique key (`pay-INV-15523-cobalt-labs`) so a repeat request can't pay it twice. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

As you asked, I didn't touch INV-89190 ($3,526.06), the invoice under dispute; it's still approved but unpaid.
